content.short: Software lab building stablecoin credit products for borrowers banks cannot underwrite.
content.description: Yumi Labs, founded in 2025 in Panama, builds credit on stablecoin rails for people and assets that traditional banks turn away, starting with an on-chain buy-now-pay-later product. Its backers include people from Avalanche, ether.fi, the Ethereum Foundation, Resolv, GMX and Four Pillars.
content.meta: Yumi Finance builds on-chain credit and buy-now-pay-later products on stablecoin rails for the underbanked.
